notes.title: UPDATE #1
notes.content:
[h1]Zhive v1.0.5   is now online![/h1]

Hello Everyone. A small but no less important update is now online.

[list]
[*]The gameover achievement should now be working properly.
[*]Fixed the collision of some areas where the soldiers could shoot tru the walls.
[*]Only the sounds closer to the camera will now be heard now.
[*]Fixed the music and sfx volume sliders.
[*]Very minor performance improvements
[/list]

And we continue working on the rest of the material in the bugs thread and the remaining maps.

Thanks!
